intro: After the first message, Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village says the Wildhammer and their gryphons are as close as a troll and a mate. Disgusting, but it can be used against them. Otho wants gryphons in the Hinterlands killed for their feathers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: They say the Wildhammer and gryphon are as close to each other as troll and mate. Disgusting, but we be able to use this to our advantage, mon. We send them another message.
Kill all the gryphons you see in the Hinterlands, collect their feathers. From this we make the final message.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The last message gonna scare them off for sure. Either that or make them very, very angry.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, mon, this gonna be good. One more step to go and Wildhammer see that they can't mess with troll!
